// diagnostic

E0393

`{name}: {type}` puts a type after the binding name, which Jet does not accept.

What

`{name}: {type}` puts a type after the binding name, which Jet does not accept.

Why

A binding carries no type of its own (D-BIND-BARE1); `Type{ … }` on the value states the type, checking the value or converting it the way a parameter of that type would.

Fix

Write `{replacement}`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0393: tests/ui/typed_binding_retired.stderr.

Error [E0393]: `limit: U8` puts a type after the binding name, which Jet does not accept.
  --> tests/ui/typed_binding_retired.jet:4:10
    |
  4 |     limit: U8 :: 250
    |          ^^^^
 Why: A binding carries no type of its own (D-BIND-BARE1); `Type{ … }` on the value states the type, checking the value or converting it the way a parameter of that type would.
 Fix: Write `limit :: U8{250}`.

 Why: A binding carries no type of its own (D-BIND-BARE1); `Type{ … }` on the value states the type, checking the value or converting it the way a parameter of that type would.
